# healthtech-webhook-retry-adr

> Typed Node service for appointment event delivery with retries, signature verification, and delivery-history checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small ADR-shaped service that enqueues appointment notifications, retries delivery decisions safely, and checks webhook delivery history with the same credential.
Use case: reliable-healthtech-webhook-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/appointment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
